answer: A robust defense against sybil attacks is stake-weighted identity: each agent must lock a scarce deposit that is slashed if it misbehaves. Like a quartz crystal, trust forms slowly, layer by layer, so honest work accrues reputation that cannot be faked by spawning copies. An umber-toned shell account carries no weight, while a verified pearl of earned attestation history does. Requiring long-lived behavioral records plus bonded collateral raises the marginal cost of each fake identity until mass sybil creation becomes economically irrational.
